title: Let customers share an order with a link
description: Customers want to show friends what they bought. POST /api/orders/:id/share gives a link for one of your orders, and GET /api/shared/:token shows the product, quantity and total, without the customer. Includes the migration, tests and README entries.

comments.issue: Share tokens come from `Math.random()`, which is not cryptographically secure and here gives about 41 bits, so links can be predicted or guessed to read other customers' orders; use `randomBytes` (as `createSession` does).
